correction_summary: Eliminated ungrounded claims of runtime 60fps / 120fps and hardware testing on unbuilt native binaries. Replaced with rigorous design feasibility classifications and designated runtime profiling protocols.

ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.rationale: Design relies on flat container colors (#161B22), hairline borders (#30363D), and standard elevation. Zero RenderEffect blurs, zero custom shaders, zero heavy animated gradients.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.rationale: Design uses standard Apple system components (NavigationStack, TabView, List). Thin materials limited to system navigation chrome (.bar); zero full-screen blur passes.

profiling_tools: JankStats / FrameMetrics (measuring frame deadline misses on 60Hz display)
Android Studio Memory Profiler (allocations, heap dump triage)
Physical Device Validation on Vivo Y19 (MediaTek Helio P65 / Android 12 / API 31)
Core Animation Instrument (FPS, hitch duration per frame, commit time)
Energy Log (thermal state impact during Active Trip execution)
Physical Device Validation on physical iPhone hardware
